sources.title: Azareye’h Thomas has caught Aaron Glenn’s eye while making most of Jets chance
sources.description: Thomas entered training camp in a battle with Nahshon Wright — who led the NFL with eight individual takeaways last season — for the starting cornerback spot across from Brandon Stephens.
